name: Lead enrichment and send-time optimization with IPGeolocation

parameters.content:
## Lead enrichment and send-time optimization with IPGeolocation

### How it works

This workflow receives a lead via webhook, normalizes and validates the submitted IP address, then branches based on whether the IP looks valid. Valid leads are enriched with IPGeolocation location and timezone data, combined into a clean lead profile that can include send-time optimization details, and returned to the caller. Invalid IP submissions are stopped early with a 400-style webhook response.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Webhook trigger URL and ensure the caller sends the expected lead fields, especially the IP address field used by the validation code.
- Add valid IPGeolocation credentials or API key configuration to the IPGeolocation nodes.
- Review the Validate IP Address code node so its payload field names match the incoming webhook body.
- Confirm the Respond to Webhook nodes use the intended status codes and response body format for your API clients.

### Customization

Adjust the Build Lead Profile code to change which geolocation fields are returned, how timezone data is converted into recommended send times, or what fallback behavior should apply when location data is incomplete.

## Receive and validate lead

Accepts the incoming lead webhook, normalizes the payload, checks IPv4/IPv6 syntax, and routes the workflow based on whether the IP address appears valid.

## Enrich valid lead

Uses IPGeolocation to retrieve location and timezone details for valid IPs, then combines those results into a structured enriched lead profile before returning it to the webhook caller.

## Reject invalid IP

Handles the invalid-IP branch with a dedicated webhook response, returning an error without attempting enrichment.
